findings.claim: Every invalid-name assertion in the new scope tests passes with validateScopeName removed, and UnarchiveScope has no invalid-name case at all, so spec-8's required 'traversal / archived name -> error' case (Tests table, TestStoreArchiveScope/TestStoreUnarchiveScope/TestStoreDeleteScope row) is not actually pinned. Sequence: delete the validateScopeName calls in ArchiveScope/DeleteScope/UnarchiveScope -> ArchiveScope("../evil") still errors (Rename of a nonexistent <root>/../evil), ArchiveScope("archived") still errors (rename of archived/ into itself), ArchiveScope("") still errors (target = archived/ exists), DeleteScope("../evil") and DeleteScope("archived") still error (Stat of a nonexistent path) -> suite green, while DeleteScope("../livescope") would then RemoveAll the live sessions/livescope folder and UnarchiveScope("../x") would move sessions/x out of the sessions dir.
findings.evidence: Re-read internal/sessions/sessions.go:221-230 and 298-382 and sessions_test.go:208-264 at the pinned head.
